main_rule: main is bound by gsl/epoch/DESIGN_EPOCH.json and cannot self-promote that binding to ACCEPTED.
feature_branch_rule: A feature branch inherits the pull request base DesignEpoch unless it carries a proposal under gsl/epoch/proposals/. Inheritance does not grant authority to change the epoch.
proposal_rule: A branch epoch proposal is always CANDIDATE, must name predecessor_design_epoch_ref, candidate_design_epoch_ref, exact canonical/source roots, invalidators, and migration evidence. It cannot change the protected-base authority used to admit its own PR.
merge_rule: Ordinary implementation PRs must target the base DesignEpoch. A PR proposing a new DesignEpoch is constitutional and remains candidate until the protected-base constitutional gate and human canonical-promotion boundary are satisfied.
staleness_rule: If the base DesignEpoch advances before merge, branch findings/tests/deltas bound to the predecessor become STALE and must be re-derived or explicitly migrated.
